September 19, 2002
Page 2
ATC Protect No 15-19125-0350

Mr Bernard P Orlan
Wipe Samples for PCBs
PS 124M

Results

ATC submitted three (3) samples for PCBs to PSC for analysis. A copy of the analytical
laboratory report is provided in the Attachment.
The samples were analyzed for seven PCB compounds with differing percentages of
chlorine.
The PCB result for all the samples were below the reporting limits (2 0
micrograms/sample) for the analysis

Currently, the Environmental Protection Agency spill clean-up standard for PCBs on
non-porous surfaces is 10 micrograms per 100 square centimeters or less (<10ug/100cm^)
as stated m 40 CFR 761.
It is our pleasure to provide these indoor environmental services to the New York City
Department of Education. If you have any questions about this report, please call (212)
353-8280, extension 370 or 212.

Sincerely,
A TC ASSOCIA TES INC.
